exposure: paternal family history of premature atherosclerotic disease (coronary heart disease, stroke)
cohort: Fathers aged 18-50 years from Norway who participated in health surveys and had singleton births registered in the Medical Birth Registry of Norway, totaling 512,111 births.
finding: The study found no association between paternal family history of premature atherosclerotic disease (CHD or stroke) and perinatal death, stillbirth, or neonatal death.
followup_time: Up to 28 days after birth (for neonatal death)
